title: London sweeps Asia
prompt: It is 03:30 ET. Read the chart and decide.

intro.beginner: The Asia session has finished and London is open. The same ideas apply, with different pools of liquidity.

whyNot.label: waiting for the NY open
whyNot.why: The sequence has already happened: Asia low swept, displacement, retrace into the gap. The New York open might be another opportunity; it isn't a reason to wait on this one.

whyNot.label: the bearish 5m gap in the pullback
whyNot.why: It's the retrace itself, against the move.

reference.summary: London sweeps the Asia low at 03:05, displaces up through the last 5m high, and retraces into the gap it left. The Asia high is the draw. A valid long outside the New York window.

bias.why: Higher highs and higher lows on the Daily and 4H; the Asia selloff was a pullback.

decision.why: Asia low swept, displacement and a defined entry with a clear draw: a valid long. Waiting for the retrace into the gap is just as sound.

take.why: Liquidity taken, displacement, a defined entry and a draw.

draw.why: The Asia high is the pool above.

annotations.label: Asia low 20,724
annotations.why: The obvious sell-side liquidity: the session's low, taken at 03:05.

annotations.label: Asia high 20,840.25
annotations.why: The pool above and the draw.
annotations.decisionNote: Sets the target and the reward for the whole trade.

annotations.label: 5m bearish FVG in the pullback
annotations.whyNot: A gap against displacement is the pullback.

confluences.why: The model works in any window.
